verdict.rationale: Genie lets business users ask natural-language data questions and get answers grounded in organizational data (docs-8, docs-22, docs-57), backed by a semantic layer (metric views, docs-7/16/42) that defines metrics once for consistent reuse, and Unity Catalog governance enforcing access control and lineage on every query (docs-19, docs-38). This directly matches the story of governed, semantically-grounded NL answers rather than ad-hoc hallucinated joins. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating accuracy claims and no community corroboration specifically testing Genie's anti-hallucination behavior.
